name: 以下犯上之后宫章妃传
original_name: 以下犯上之后宫章妃传
overview: After his soul is transported into an ancient imperial harem, modern CEO Zhang Fei awakens in the body of Consort Zhang, a woman condemned to death. Forced into deadly palace politics, he must fight to survive by seizing power, all while grappling with his new identity and the harsh realities of life as a woman.
